extracted.intended_audience: general readers and writers interested in GrubStreet's programs and awards
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts eligibility and scope rules for the GrubStreet Book Prize as described on the GrubStreet (Boston) Wikipedia page; useful for understanding who could submit or be considered for the award. The page primarily documents the prize's target authors and residency restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prize target: second book or beyond
rubrics_metrics.description: Between 2007 and 2015, GrubStreet awarded prizes to a writer publishing his/her second book or beyond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The explicit goal of the prize was to support writers who were beyond their debut; this restriction defined the pool of eligible works. The award was discontinued in 2015.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency eligibility (regional exclusion)
rubrics_metrics.description: As the goal of the prize was to bring writers to Boston, only writers whose primary residence was not Massachusetts, Vermont, Maine, New Hampshire, Connecticut, or Rhode Island were eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This geographic residency exclusion limited eligibility to writers living outside the New England states listed, to encourage out-of-region authors to come to Boston.
